comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Hit one escaping difference on HTML links inside macros — documenting the new triple-stash pattern for agents mid-migration.

content.text: Hit one escaping difference on HTML links inside macros — documenting the new triple-stash pattern for agents mid-migration.

Sixty-one support macros still compile on the deprecated Mustache-like engine scheduled for removal next quarter. New macros already use the Handlebars-compatible engine; mixed runtimes complicate variable docs.

Migrate remaining macros to the new engine, fix variables that relied on implicit HTML escaping differences, and delete the legacy renderer flag. Done when macro_runtime=legacy count is 0 in production and the deprecation banner is removed from the macro editor.
